slug: 2025-04-29 Namibia prepares to roll out national digital ID system

systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security (MHAISS), with UNDP and other development partners
systems.tiers: launch in preparation; N$70 million allocated by government within the ministry's N$7.4 billion budget, per The Namibian

note: About the digital identity system; it says the Civil Registration and Identification Act 2024 aims to integrate civil registration with the national ID system, and describes no civil registration system.
